name: GUH
recent: GUH 于 2026 年 11 月 23 日公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，电子业务回升带动单季转盈 246 万令吉。公司于 9 月 28 日收到苏州土地收回的最后一笔补偿金人民币 3,900 万元，累计人民币 1.95 亿元已全部收齐。期间亦多次公告与 Kiyamas Eastern Drill 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出预估逾 40%。
notable: 收到苏州政府就土地收回支付的最后一笔补偿金人民币 3,900 万元，累计人民币 1.95 亿元已全部收齐。
2026 财年第三季度转盈 246 万令吉，电子业务回升。
与 Kiyamas Eastern Drill 的经常性关联交易实际金额累计达 168.9 万令吉，较预估 120 万令吉高出 40.76%。
risks: 与 Kiyamas Eastern Drill 的经常性关联交易实际金额多次超出预估，累计偏差达 40.76%。
首席执行官兼集团董事经理 Datuk Seri Kenneth H'ng Bak Tee 在闭市期前表示有意买卖公司证券，并在 10 月 20 日以每股 0.241 令吉增持 13 万股。

news.title: GUH Holdings Swings to Q3 FY2026 Profit of RM2.46 Million as Electronics Division Rebounds
GUH receives last Suzhou land payout
GUH receives final payment for Suzhou land transfer
GUH receives final compensation payment for Suzhou land disposal
GUH completes Suzhou land use rights disposal after final CNY39m payment

recent_en: GUH announced its Q3 FY2026 results on 23 November 2026, swinging to a RM2.46 million profit as the electronics division rebounded. On 28 September 2026 the company received the final CNY39 million compensation for the Suzhou land repossession, completing the full CNY195 million. It also made several announcements that actual recurrent related party transactions with Kiyamas Eastern Drill exceeded the estimated value by over 40%.
notable_en: Received the final CNY39 million compensation from the Suzhou government for the land repossession, completing the full CNY195 million.
Swung to a RM2.46 million profit in Q3 FY2026 as the electronics division rebounded.
Cumulative actual recurrent related party transactions with Kiyamas Eastern Drill reached RM1.689 million, 40.76% above the estimated RM1.2 million.
risks_en: Actual recurrent related party transactions with Kiyamas Eastern Drill repeatedly exceeded estimates, with cumulative deviation reaching 40.76%.
CEO and Group Managing Director Datuk Seri Kenneth H'ng Bak Tee indicated intention to deal during the closed period and acquired 130,000 shares at RM0.241 each on 20 October 2026.
